'''Chapter 1175''' is titled "Nidhöggr".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Sabo]] with koala babies hanging all over him" by Ramenmaru.

==Short Summary==
As [[Sanji]] frees [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Loki]] deposits the giant children and parents at Western Village, upon learning from Loki's announcement of the children surviving, [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]]' plan to recapture them turns into an assassination attempt when they chose to protect their parents. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] blocks Sommers' attack and  [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] using a [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 5 Techniques|Gear 5]] [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Haki]] technique takes down the Knight of God, with Loki then crushing him. While observing the battle, [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] recalls the day he learned about Loki's [[Devil Fruit]] [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr|ability]] with [[Shanks]] from [[Jarul]], as [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] is surprised that the Devil Fruit had been in [[Elbaph]] all along.

==Long Summary==
[[Sanji]] uses [[Black Leg Style/Diable Jambe|Diable Jambe]] to burn away the [[Iba Iba no Mi|thorns]] around [[Nico Robin|Robin]], thereby freeing her, and though everyone is grateful, they also know they cannot relax just yet. At Western Village, the injured parents are dropped off along with their children as they beg for someone to save them. Some giants try to ask [[Loki]] to take everyone elsewhere since the village is currently under attack, but Loki states he does not care and will only drop people off that are on his back right now, like he wants [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] to do, but he just calls out to [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]]. Thanks to Loki, though, [[Jarul]] is able to send a message across [[Elbaph]] that the children have been rescued, which solves their hostage problem. Zoro tells Luffy that he needs to take out the [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Kirin|MMAs]], but he then hears a sound, which turns out to be [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]] shooting thorns at the giants, furious that everyone survived.

Despite his anger, Sommers says he can still take the children to [[Mary Geoise]] since they are still alive, but he first wants to dispose of their parents. The children stand between him and their parents, declaring they will protect them this time, and upon seeing this, Sommers is overwhelmed with twisted emotion to the point he says he no longer cares about the mission; he just wants to kill them and shoots his thorns, though Zoro intercepts them. Luffy then goes into the air and grabs a bolt of lightning created by Loki, and after locking in on Sommers, he envelopes his arm in the electricity and punches Sommers with ''Gomu Gomu no Dawn Thor Rifle'', which is so powerful it blasts Sommers to pieces and causes his thorns wrapped around the children to disappear. 

Seeing Luffy in [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 5 Techniques|Gear Fifth]], [[Ripley]] says she believes he is the Warrior of Liberation, [[Nika]], as she passes out, while Sommers yells that Nika is nothing more than a bedtime story. Just then, he gets crushed by Loki, who everyone says resembles "Nidhöggr" in his transformed state. In the distance, [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] and [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] watch as the latter thinks back to the day of [[Harald]]'s death. 

On that day, Jarul revealed to [[Shanks]] and Gaban that the [[Devil Fruit]] Loki ate was the [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr]], and that no matter who eats it, they will become the largest dragon in existence. With that said, Jarul explains that the maximum size of the beast corresponds with the size of the user, so compared to a regular human and even a Giant, an Ancient Giant will be draw out the fruit's full potential if consumed by one. Shanks asks if the reason why no one ate before was because it was too powerful, but Jarul informs him that no one ate it before because [[Ragnir]] forbid it so. According to legend, there was once a "Warrior God" who wielded Ragnir as their personal weapon and was the previous user of the Devil Fruit, which they used to fight the Sun God, and was accompanied by Ratatoskr, also known as the "Ice Squirrel". Jarul says that when Ratatoskr lost its master, it took up residence in Ragnir and was waiting for its master to return, but now it has chosen Loki to embrace its former master's power. 

Speaking of, Loki starts chasing after the rest of [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]]'s MMAs, which were now fleeing for their lives, but Loki obliterates them all with a blast of lightning from his mouth, a move he calls ''Thorheim''. In the Holy Land, [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] becomes furious to learn that the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr, was in Elbaph all along. 

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Sanji]] frees [[Nico Robin|Robin]] from [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]]' [[Iba Iba no Mi|thorns]] via [[Black Leg Style/Diable Jambe|Diable Jambe]].
**It is revealed that Sommers' thorns can be destroyed using heat.
*[[Loki]] drops off the injured children and parents to the Western Village, as [[Jarul]] announced to the rest of [[Elbaph]] that all the hostages has been rescued.
*After Sommers realized that the children are still alive, he arrives at the Western Village to retake them to [[Mary Geoise]].
**As Sommers said that he wanted to finish off the parents, the children volunteer to protect their parents. As they get in his way, Sommers tries to kill them all, though his thorn bullets are repelled by [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]].
*Upon noticing Sommers, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] strikes him with ''Gomu Gomu no Dawn Thor Rifle'', a punch combined with Loki's electric power. This results in Sommers being blown into pieces and causes his thorns wrapped around the children to disappear.
**As everyone notices Luffy's resemblance to [[Nika]], Sommers' mangled body is then crushed by Loki.
*In the distance, [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] observe the battle as the former recollects the day of [[Harald]]'s death.
**In the flashback, Jarul revealed to Gaban and [[Shanks]] that Elbaph's "national treasure" [[Devil Fruit]] that Loki ate is the [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr]].
***According to Jarul, the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr allowed the user to transform into Nidhöggr, the "largest dragon in existence", and that the size of the beast form is corresponding to the user's, therefore only an [[Giants#Ancient Giants|Ancient Giant]] will be able to draw out its full potential.
**In the same flashback, Jarul also revealed the legend story about [[Ragnir]]'s origin:
***In the legend, Ragnir was once a weapon of the "[[Warrior God]]", the previous user of the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr who once used the hammer to battle Nika. They were accompanied by [[Ratatoskr]], the "Ice Squirrel" who later "took residence" in Ragnir after its master's death to wait for their return.
*As Loki obliterates [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]]'s MMAs, [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] became furious after realizing that the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr was in Elbaph all along.
